fato_historico: 1927: Columbine Mine massacre: Striking coal miners are allegedly attacked with machine guns by a detachment of Colorado state police dressed in civilian clothes.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos invites you to cultivate quiet strength, Taurus. While echoes of past conflicts remind us how shadows once clouded human history, today suggests you choose peace and unwavering growth. It is a good time to tend to your garden of stability, nurturing your soul and considering how your grounded presence can foster harmony in your personal sanctuary.
frase_do_dia: Quiet strength is the most powerful foundation for building a truly beautiful life.
significado_numero: Represents the path toward inner wisdom and shedding heavy past burdens.
conselho: Prioritize your comfort and listen deeply to the rhythm of your own heart.
